name: lucid
description: Flags database leaks and other risks in each commit before you ship them, and explains your changes in plain English.

lucid.autoExplain.description: Explain each new commit automatically, in the background.

enumDescriptions: Warnings about risky changes, and lessons about the rest.
Only warnings about risky changes pop up.
lucid.lessons.description: Lessons about changes that carry no risk. Warnings always pop up.

lucid.prove.description: Test warnings about database rules in Lucid's disposable sandbox, with fake users. Sends your database setup files only (migrations, schema.sql), before and after the commit; never data or other code. Needs GitHub sign-in.

lucid.useOwnKeys.description: Use your own Meta and Baseten keys (set with "Lucid: Set API keys") instead of Lucid's server. Your filtered diff then goes straight to Meta and Baseten.

lucid.serverUrl.description: The Lucid server that writes lessons when you are signed in with GitHub.

scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --out lucid.vsix
